AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
DevFest Ourense 2026 agenda (7 Nov) and the user's favourite sessions.
Operational Patterns: - Resolve sessions with 'searchTalks' before calling 'addToFavorites'. - Prefer one 'addToFavorites' call with several IDs. - Find a session by speaker or title with the 'query' of 'searchTalks'.
Constraints: - 'clearFavorites' is irreversible: confirm with the user first. - Times are local to the event, formatted HH:mm. - Tracks are an unofficial classification.
